import sys, random, math, time
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from te.worker_solver import solve_worker
exec(open('tmp/test_worker.py').read().split('random.seed(0)')[0])
for mode in ['route','admit']:
  for rho in [1,8]:
    for trial in range(100):
      E=64;K=24
      caps=[random.choice([0,1,1,2,10,1000]) for _ in range(E)]
      dem=[random.choice([1,2,1000]) for _ in range(K)]
      paths=[]
      # all 96 slots, repeated random 12-edge paths
      for k in range(K):
        m=4
        pp=[]
        for j in range(m):
          if random.random()<0.05: pp.append(None)
          else: pp.append(random.sample(range(E),12))
        paths.append(pp)
      owned=list(range(K))
      B=[random.choice([-1e6,-1e3,0,1e3,1e6]) for _ in range(E)]
      res=solve_worker(caps,dem,paths,owned,mode,rho,B)
      if not check(caps,dem,paths,owned,mode,rho,B,res):
        print('FAIL',mode,rho,trial);print(caps);print(dem);print(paths);print(B);print(res);raise SystemExit
    print('ok',mode,rho)
print('all adv ok')
